QUOTE: `include/mbedtls/mbedtls_config.h:3787` has `//#define MBEDTLS_THREADING_C`, so the threading layer is off. Neither `MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD` nor `MBEDTLS_THREADING_ALT` is selected
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer names MBEDTLS_THREADING_C and MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD as the config macros that control the threading layer. It also says that `library/threading.c` compiles to nothing without THREADING_C, so THREADING_C gates it.
